test_default_stream_configuration.title: Verify default video stream configuration across all 3 streams

steps.action: Open Setup (it opens on VIDEO CONFIGURATION).
steps.expected: The VIDEO CONFIGURATION page is shown.

Three streams; Stream 1 is H.265 at the registry's max resolution for this unit (2592x1944, 4000x3000 on FC-12F-1) and Stream 3 is M-JPEG. Stream 2's resolution is a per-unit setting and is only read.

steps.action: Read the Stream 1 codec and resolution fields.
steps.expected: They show the same codec and resolution as the table's first row.

test_stream_codec_and_resolution_change.title: Verify the stream codec can be changed and applied

steps.action: Open Setup > VIDEO CONFIGURATION and note the Stream 1 codec in the stream table.
steps.expected: The table's first row shows the current codec (H.265 on every lab unit).

steps.action: Change the codec to H.264 and click Apply.
steps.expected: Within 30 seconds the table's first row reads H.264 (the camera re-reads its settings a few seconds after Apply).

steps.action: Put the original codec back and click Apply.
steps.expected: Within 30 seconds the table's first row reads the original codec and frame rate again (a codec change resets the rate to 30, so the test puts it back); the test restores both even when a step fails, and fails by name if the camera is left changed.

test_osd_configuration.title: Verify OSD date/time overlay is enabled and configurable

steps.action: On the Setup page, open OSD.
steps.expected: The ON SCREEN DISPLAY page shows the Date & time setting.
A text colour control is shown, Position X and Y fields are present, and a User text section with its Off/On toggle.

test_audio_configuration_defaults.title: Verify audio configuration defaults and controls

steps.action: On the Setup page, open AUDIO.
steps.expected: The AUDIO CONFIGURATION page shows the Audio encode setting.
Codec is G.711 ulaw, Volume is 10 and Sample rate is 8,000 Hz.
Audio out (or Audio alarm) with channels and volume is shown, with 16,000 Hz among the output sample rates.
